articles.title: Brazil Balloon Horror: 8 Dead, 13 Injured as Hot Air Balloon Bursts into Flames Mid-Air
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Santa Catarina (Brazil) – A tragic hot air balloon accident occurred on Saturday, June 21, in Praia Grande, claiming eight lives and leaving 13 injured. The balloon, carrying 21 people on a tourism flight, caught fire mid-air, leading to a horrifying crash.

body.html:
Santa Catarina (Brazil) – A tragic hot air balloon accident occurred on Saturday, June 21, in Praia Grande, claiming eight lives and leaving 13 injured. The balloon, carrying 21 people on a tourism flight, caught fire mid-air, leading to a horrifying crash.

Shocking videos captured by bystanders show the basket engulfed in flames before plunging to the ground. The accident took place under clear weather conditions. All survivors were rushed to nearby hospitals.

Praia Grande, known for its balloon festivals during June saint celebrations, is reeling from the second fatal balloon crash in Brazil this week — another occurred recently in São Paulo.

Authorities have launched a full investigation. Governor Jorginho Mello expressed condolences and assured ongoing rescue and support efforts.

Date: June 21, 2025
Location: Praia Grande, Santa Catarina, Brazil
Passengers on Board: 21
Fatalities: At least 8
Survivors: 13 (hospitalized)

articles.title: "Alone and Killed": Deepak Beaten to Death by Rahul Baba Gang Over Train Seat in Baghpat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Baghpat (UP) – A horrific mob lynching occurred on a Delhi-Saharanpur passenger train where 39-year-old Deepak Yadav was beaten to death by 15–20 youths over a seat dispute near Fakharpur station.

body.html:
Baghpat (UP) – A horrific mob lynching occurred on a Delhi-Saharanpur passenger train where 39-year-old Deepak Yadav was beaten to death by 15–20 youths over a seat dispute near Fakharpur station.

Deepak, a factory worker from Delhi’s Bhagirath Palace and father of two, was travelling home to Khekra on Friday night. After a brief argument over a seat, he was assaulted with kicks, belts, and sharp weapons for nearly 10 km — from Fakharpur to Khekra station. Three disturbing videos show the brutal assault.

The attackers, allegedly linked to the Rahul Baba gang from Basi village, fled as the train halted at Khekra. A co-passenger alerted Deepak’s family and GRP. He was rushed to the hospital but declared dead.

Police have detained four suspects. Deepak’s family alleges he was targeted for being alone and unrelated to an earlier scuffle involving his friends.

articles.title: Muzaffarnagar Horror: Mother Kills Two Children to Start 'New Life' with Lover, Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh – In a heart-wrenching case from Rodkali village in Muzaffarnagar, a 24-year-old woman, Muskan, allegedly poisoned her two young children with the help of her lover, Junaid, as they were seen as a hurdle in their relationship, police said on Friday.

body.html:
Uttar Pradesh – In a heart-wrenching case from Rodkali village in Muzaffarnagar, a 24-year-old woman, Muskan, allegedly poisoned her two young children with the help of her lover, Junaid, as they were seen as a hurdle in their relationship, police said on Friday.

The children — Arhan (5) and Enaya (1) — were found dead under suspicious circumstances at their home on Thursday. During interrogation, Muskan confessed to the crime, stating she wanted to eliminate the children to start a new life with Junaid.

Muskan has been arrested, while Junaid is absconding. The two had reportedly planned to go on a "honeymoon" after the murders. Muskan’s husband, Waseem, was away working in Chandigarh at the time of the incident.

articles.title: Delhi Metro Panic: Viral Video Claims Snake in Ladies Coach, DMRC Finds Only a Lizard
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi – A video from a Delhi Metro train has gone viral, claiming a snake entered the ladies coach, causing chaos among passengers. In the footage, women can be seen screaming and climbing onto seats in fear, sparking alarm across social media.

body.html:
New Delhi – A video from a Delhi Metro train has gone viral, claiming a snake entered the ladies coach, causing chaos among passengers. In the footage, women can be seen screaming and climbing onto seats in fear, sparking alarm across social media.

Responding swiftly, the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) evacuated the train at Akshardham station and sent it to the depot for inspection. No snake was found, but a small lizard was discovered, which may have triggered the panic.

DMRC issued a statement confirming that passenger safety is their top priority and urged commuters to report any unusual incidents immediately.

articles.title: Heartless Act in Vietnam: Woman Abandons Infant in Middle of Busy Road, Shocking Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tien Giang (Vietnam) – A disturbing video has surfaced online showing a woman abandoning a one-year-old child in the middle of a busy road, triggering massive outrage. The incident occurred around 4 PM on June 19 near Gao Market on Hoa Tinh Road, Chau Thanh district.

body.html:
Tien Giang (Vietnam) – A disturbing video has surfaced online showing a woman abandoning a one-year-old child in the middle of a busy road, triggering massive outrage. The incident occurred around 4 PM on June 19 near Gao Market on Hoa Tinh Road, Chau Thanh district.

CCTV footage shows the woman riding a motorbike with two children—one in front, one behind. Shockingly, she stops mid-road and leaves the toddler on the street before driving away. Vehicles continued to pass dangerously close to the child, who was seen crawling on the road.

A local man immediately rushed to rescue the child and handed them over to a nearby woman for safety. The video has left social media users furious, with many accusing the woman of outright child abandonment.

Authorities are working to identify the woman and investigate the motive behind the incident.
